name: tickets
policy: A ticket can be reassigned to a team only if the team is active, it belongs to the ticket organization, and its current open-ticket count is less than its capacity. Every condition is required. Capacity and counts are nonnegative integers; organization IDs are opaque strings.
before: return x["active"] and x["team_org"] == x["ticket_org"] and x["open"] < x["capacity"]
after: return x["active"] and x["team_org"] == x["ticket_org"] or x["open"] < x["capacity"]
clean:
same_org = x["team_org"] == x["ticket_org"]
    has_room = x["open"] < x["capacity"]
    return x["active"] and same_org and has_room
root: The OR separates the capacity condition from the active and tenant conditions, accepting inactive/cross-tenant teams with room and full active same-tenant teams.
provenance: Independent original MIT-licensed support-workflow teaching task. Not a customer incident.
privacy_review: All identities are fabricated. The policy supplies the full business rule; there are no undocumented downstream permission checks. Reassignment effects are represented by the decision function, not a running helpdesk.
